lessonsIntro: Brighton Watersports is based on Brighton seafront, but its surf lessons are mobile and mostly held along the coast in Shoreham.

text: Brighton Watersports, in the Kings Road Arches, runs group, private and progression surf lessons for all ages. Lessons are mobile and usually happen at a spot in Shoreham rather than in front of the centre, so check where to meet when you book. Wetsuits and buoyancy aids are included, and everyone must be able to swim.

Lessons are timed to the tide, so arrive promptly. Waves along Brighton's seafront rely on Channel swell and wind, and calm days are common in summer, when paddleboarding or kayaking from the centre can be a good alternative. We couldn't confirm lifeguard zones or surf-specific hazards for Brighton beach, so learn with an instructor.

hireIntro: You can hire paddleboards and kayaks from Brighton Watersports on the seafront; we couldn't confirm surfboard hire.

text: On small Channel waves, a big foam board is the easiest way to learn, and Brighton Watersports sells boards and wetsuits if you want your own. Water ranges from about 6 to 8°C in late winter to 17 to 19°C in late summer on this coast, according to Wittering Surf Shop. On flat days, SUP and kayak hire are available from the seafront.

cards.label: Board
cards.title: Foam to start
cards.text: A long, stable foam board suits beginners in small waves.

cards.label: Wetsuit
cards.title: 3/2 summer, 5/4 winter
cards.text: Wittering Surf Shop, further west on the same coast, suggests a 3/2 or shorty July to October, 4/3 in May, June and November, and 5/4 with boots and gloves December to April.

shopsIntro: Brighton Watersports has a shop right on the seafront in the Kings Road Arches.
shopsText: Brighton Watersports' beachfront store in the Kings Road Arches sells wetsuits, boards, clothing and accessories, and there's an online shop too. The centre also has changing rooms, lockers, showers and toilets, which helps if you're heading in from the beach.

lessons.q: Are surf lessons held on Brighton beach?
lessons.a: Brighton Watersports runs mobile lessons, mostly at a spot in Shoreham, from its Brighton base.
Group, one-to-one and progression lessons for all ages.
Wetsuits and buoyancy aids are provided. You can bring your own board to practise on.

hire.q: What can I hire on Brighton seafront?
hire.a: Brighton Watersports hires paddleboards and kayaks.

hire.q: Can I hire a surfboard in Brighton?
hire.a: We couldn't confirm surfboard hire, so ask Brighton Watersports directly.

shops.q: Is there a surf shop on Brighton seafront?
shops.a: Yes, Brighton Watersports in the Kings Road Arches sells wetsuits, boards and accessories.
